name: Shiroi Taitsu no Ryoshuu
source:
Dancer Rina, wearing only white tights, is locked by middle-aged men in a basement.

The mysterious middle-aged men are actually the shadowy sponsors of the ballet school. 

Rina is defiled in order to secure funding for the school...
translation:
只穿着白色紧身衣的舞者莉娜被中年男子锁在地下室里。

神秘的中年男子实际上是芭蕾舞学校的幕后赞助商。

为了确保学校的资金来源，莉娜被玷污了……
